_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_celeb_club.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_club_ongoing: The public schedule is still under the lights, while another arrangement waits backstage for confirmation.
en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_club_result: The arrangement has ended; its consequences depend on the route taken in the middle.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_01:
The booth's spot was chosen with care: lighting dim enough that 'you can't see, but you know'.
The drinks come round after round. Wedged between the lead and the manager, she takes hands under her skirt in front of the whole booth.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_02:
"Showtime."
She is ordered up onto the coffee table to dance. Nothing beneath the skirt; when the sweep of a spotlight crosses her, the whole floor's gazes land at once.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_03:
She kneels before the sofa, taking the lead and the two entourage men in turn. The rest watch over their drinks, whistle, film with their phones.
Wherever the sweep of the spotlights goes, the shutters follow.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_04:
Late in the night the second-floor annex is bought out. She is pressed into the corner of the sofa, skirt rolled to her waist, taken face-up by the lead.
The crowd doesn't disperse - some lean in to watch, some reach for her chest, some bring their phones to point-blank range.
Her hair is pulled, tilting her face up: "Face. - Smile. Smile for camera."
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_05:
At closing, the manager smooths her skirt down like putting away a prop.
"Tokyo girls, so open! - Tomorrow, same itinerary."
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_err: [ERROR] Scene targets missing (no party, or the client could not be borrowed from the Kiryu-gumi).
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_opening: She has just finished performing for the public when staff quietly hand over another arrangement. The smile remains in the photographs, but backstage her time has already been divided into smaller boxes.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_choose_full: Follow the original arrangement and finish both parts.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_choose_firs: Handle only the urgent part and protect the public schedule.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_choose_skip: Decline for now and preserve the next public appearance.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_question: The backstage staff are waiting for an answer. Which expectation comes first?
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_phase_1_val: The first arrangement is complete. She steadies her breathing and remembers what expression the next camera will need.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_phase_2_val: The second arrangement is over as well. The noise outside draws close again, and she folds the private time back into the schedule without putting it in the public record.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_first_only_: The urgent part is complete. She checks the time and decides not to push the next public appearance into dangerous territory.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_summary_com: Both arrangements are complete. There is no answer that explains everything for her, so she simply reorganizes the remaining time and the next appearance.
Only the first arrangement is complete. Its cost and benefit remain backstage; at least the next public appearance can begin on time.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_summary_fai: The arrangement does not finish cleanly. She checks that she can still make the public appearance before staff remove the incomplete record.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_summary_ski: She declines the backstage arrangement and keeps the time for the next public appearance. It will not satisfy everyone, but it is her decision.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_club_writer_summary_err: The site cannot confirm whether the arrangement can continue. Staff stop first, rather than treating an unconfirmed record as fact.
